cornerstone.holders: GIC; HHLRA; HIM; CPE; UBS AM Singapore; Taikang Life; Eastspring (Eastspring Singapore; Eastpring HK); Pinpoint; ICBC Wealth; MWAL; Millennium; PSBC Wealth; Fullgoal (Fullgoal HK; Fullgoal Fund)
cornerstone.full_quote: Each of the Cornerstone Investors has agreed that it will not, whether directly or indirectly, at any time during the period of six months from (and inclusive of) the Listing Date (the “Lock-up Period”), dispose of, in any way, any of the Offer Shares or any interest in any company or entity holding such Offer Shares that they have purchased pursuant to the relevant Cornerstone Investment Agreement
cornerstone.basis: six calendar months from (and inclusive of) the Listing Date; frees up on the six-month anniversary
cornerstone.notes: Investor names from the cornerstone table on p.204.

controller_6m.full_quote: (i) in the period commencing on the date of this prospectus and ending on the date which is six months from the Listing Date, dispose of, or enter into any agreement to dispose of or otherwise create any options, rights, interests or encumbrances in respect of, any of the Shares in respect of which any of them is shown by this prospectus to be the beneficial owner (the “Relevant Shares”)
controller_6m.basis: Rule 10.07 undertaking: period from prospectus date ending ON the date which is six months from the Listing Date; inclusive endpoint, first free day is the day after the six-month anniversary

controller_12m.full_quote: (ii) in the period of six months commencing on the date on which the period referred to in paragraph (i) above expires, dispose of, or enter into any agreement to dispose of or otherwise create any options, rights, interests or encumbrances in respect of, the Relevant Shares if, immediately following such disposal or upon the exercise or enforcement of such options, rights, interests or encumbrances, they would cease to be our Controlling Shareholders for the purpose of the Listing Rules.
controller_12m.basis: Rule 10.07(1)(b)-style undertaking: second six-month period commencing on expiry of the first (six months from the Listing Date); frees up on the 12-month anniversary of the Listing Date
controller_12m.notes: Conditional on ceasing to be Controlling Shareholders; effective control maintenance = 12 months from Listing Date.
